title: No supported read route exposes a session's Engram-disabled state
outcome: An operator or runner can check, through one supported read-only route and without store access, whether each TermAl session's Engram integration is disabled, and why and since when.
acceptance: A behavioural test disables a session's Engram integration through a genuine session-disabling control error and shows that the supported read-only route reports that session as disabled, with the disabling code and time; a session that was never disabled reports enabled.
The route needs no store access and grants no new authority; existing disable and re-enable behaviour is unchanged.
